quizName:
Hardest Questions in Colorado
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions on the road ahead. This sign tells you that traffic is coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar car from a friend. What should you do?

options.text: Not worry about it because all cars are the same.
Don't tell your friend that you are unfamiliar with the car.
Ignore any problems with the car to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take time to learn where the controls are and how to use them before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take time to learn where the controls are and how to use them before driving.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar car, find where the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn are. Learn how to use each one. Fix any problems before you drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park at this location.

questions.question: What could cause you to crash?

options.text: Taking your eyes off the road
Taking your hands off the wheel
Taking your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: Anything that takes your attention away from driving can cause a crash. This includes taking your eyes off the road or your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left at this location.

questions.question: On a freeway, you miss your turn or exit. What should you do?

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your lane.
Continue to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your exit, keep going to the next one. Never back up on a freeway or shoulder. Backing up is illegal in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions on the road ahead. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming. Be ready to stop.

questions.question: Before you turn, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This tells other drivers what you plan to do.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells drivers that even when the light is green, they must let oncoming traffic pass before turning left.

questions.question: When should you slow down?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections, at railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp or blind curves, where there are pedestrians or hazards, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: What can impair your ability to drive?
questions.explanation: To drive safely, you must be in good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs (legal and illegal), and tiredness can all make driving unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you of a traffic signal ahead. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light. Watch for other vehicles crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that bicycles may cross the road ahead. Watch for bicycle traffic.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if no other cars are nearby.
Signal only if other cars are visible.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy night traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other cars are nearby.
questions.explanation: Always signal when turning, changing lanes, or pulling away from a curb. Make this a habit every time.

questions.question: You are upset from an incident at work. When you get to your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly to distract yourself.
Drive fast on the interstate to release your anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Stop at a bar for drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Take time to calm down before driving. Driving while angry or upset is dangerous for you and others on the road.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with crossing traffic is ahead.

questions.question: Who must wear a fastened safety belt in a moving vehicle?
questions.explanation: The driver and all front seat passengers must wear safety belts. Children ages 8 to 18 must wear safety belts no matter where they sit in the vehicle.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you?
questions.explanation: Alcohol weakens your judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time and coordination. Your vision and ability to judge distance get worse, making it harder to react to things around you.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching railroad tracks?

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate lowers.
Do not worry about how many tracks there are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains when approaching railroad tracks. Slow down and be ready to stop if a train is coming.

questions.question: What causes distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.

questions.explanation: You must focus on driving. You make about 200 decisions per mile. Any extra activity can distract you and cause danger.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your direction. Find another way to go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When stopped by police, what documents must you show?
questions.explanation: You must have your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance in your vehicle at all times. Have all three documents ready if stopped by police.
